addressCheck.verified: read on the organisation's own website
addressCheck.search: found through search; confirm on their website before activating

metadata.notes: Public role addresses only. Entries with email null are inactive gaps to fill. Topic ids match shared/prompts/topics_en.json on forest-leo. Reviewed 1 Oct 2026 against shared/prompts/facts_and_sources.md (28 Sept prompt pass). Journalists added 1 Oct 2026 as newsroom desks. Samebyar and SSR added 4 Oct 2026.

kinds.institution: a role address nobody personally receives; may take repeat letters, subject to its cap
kinds.person: a named person at a public role address; exactly one letter, ever

fields.remit: what they decide on, in plain terms
fields.why: one sentence the letter can open with ('we write to you because …') and the being can choose on
fields.facts: what is on record about the recipient's own actions, each with a source and the date it was checked; the only things a letter may say they did

recipients.name: Skogsstyrelsen (Swedish Forest Agency)
recipients.remit: Supervises the Forestry Act, receives felling notifications, consultation with samebyar before large fellings, woodland key habitats, nature conservation agreements.
recipients.notes: registrator@skogsstyrelsen.se is the registry address for formal submissions.
recipients.why: you receive the felling notifications and supervise the Forestry Act, so the three-week notice period and what it leaves time to find are yours to administer

facts.text: From 1 January 2027 you will handle felling notifications with a three-week review window instead of six, under the forestry law Parliament passed 308 to 21 on 16 June 2026.
Your own statistics put clear-cut-free forestry at about 733,000 hectares in 2024, around 3 per cent of productive forest.
Svensk Jakt has reported that your 5 per cent target for moose browsing damage (ÄBIN) was largely taken from the forestry industry's own target and never decided politically.

recipients.name: Naturvårdsverket (Swedish Environmental Protection Agency)
recipients.remit: Nature reserves and national parks, species protection, the national nature restoration plan, predator management, environmental objectives.
recipients.why: you hold the national restoration plan and the species protection rules that decide whether anything is allowed to grow back

facts.text: In April 2026 you handed licence-hunt decisions for lynx and wolverine to the county administrative boards.
In May 2026 you published Sweden's first national list of invasive alien species, 34 species including the garden lupine.

recipients.name: Havs- och vattenmyndigheten (Swedish Agency for Marine and Water Management)
recipients.remit: Fisheries and salmon quotas, national plan for modern environmental conditions on hydropower (omprövning), water quality standards.
recipients.why: you set the salmon quotas and run the national plan for bringing hydropower under modern environmental conditions

facts.text: On 24 June 2026 you stopped Swedish salmon fishing in the Gulf of Bothnia (ICES subdivisions 30–31) until 24 July, once the 2026 quota of 7,152 salmon was used up.

recipients.name: Bergsstaten (Mining Inspectorate of Sweden)
recipients.remit: Grants exploration permits and exploitation concessions under the Minerals Act, including on reindeer grazing land.
recipients.why: you grant the exploration permits and mining concessions that cross reindeer grazing land, including the Per Geijer decision expected this winter

facts.text: LKAB's application for the Per Geijer mining concession is with you; on 25 September 2026 the Norrbotten County Administrative Board recommended granting it, while writing that losing the reindeer migration route cannot be fully compensated. Your decision is expected around the end of November 2026.

recipients.name: SGU (Geological Survey of Sweden)
recipients.remit: Mineral strategy and critical raw materials, designates national interests for minerals, after-treatment of abandoned mines.
recipients.why: you designate the national interests for minerals and advise the state on critical raw materials

recipients.name: Energimyndigheten (Swedish Energy Agency)
recipients.remit: Energy policy analysis, wind power national interests and planning support, renewable energy targets.
recipients.why: you designate the national interests for wind power and carry the state's energy planning

recipients.name: Svenska kraftnät (Swedish transmission system operator)
recipients.remit: The national grid: new power lines through the north, long-term electricity demand forecasts.
recipients.why: you plan the power lines through this landscape, and your own forecast of industrial demand has fallen by a fifth

recipients.name: Sametinget (Sámi Parliament)
recipients.remit: Both elected Sámi parliament and state agency: reindeer husbandry administration, Sámi language and culture, consultation under the Consultation Act.
recipients.notes: Reactivated 4 Oct 2026: avoiding the Sámi institutions altogether while the council speaks about Sámi land is its own way of speaking on their behalf. Deactivated 4 Oct and reactivated the same day.
recipients.why: you are both the elected Sámi parliament and the agency that administers reindeer husbandry, and the council speaks about Sámi land — you should hear what it says, not only be spoken about

recipients.name: Jordbruksverket (Swedish Board of Agriculture)
recipients.remit: Rural development funds, agricultural landscape and grazing, the CAP in Sweden.
recipients.why: you administer the rural funds and the grazing landscape that the open land depends on

recipients.name: Trafikverket (Swedish Transport Administration)
recipients.remit: Roads and railways: landscape fragmentation, wildlife passages, reindeer and wildlife collisions.
recipients.why: your roads and railways cut this landscape into pieces, one permit at a time

recipients.name: SLU (Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences)
recipients.remit: Forest research, the national forest inventory, ArtDatabanken (red list of species).
recipients.notes: Faculty of Forest Science has its own registry: registrator-sfak@slu.se.
recipients.why: your national forest inventory and Artdatabanken produce the numbers everyone argues with, including the red list naming forestry as the largest threat

facts.text: Your Artdatabanken's red list 2025 (24 March 2026) counts 5,217 red-listed species and names modern forestry as harming 1,744 of them.
In January 2025 your researchers warned that lodgepole pine runs a very high risk of becoming invasive.

recipients.name: Landsbygds- och infrastrukturdepartementet (Ministry of Rural Affairs and Infrastructure)
recipients.remit: Forestry policy, reindeer husbandry and Sámi policy, rural affairs, infrastructure.
recipients.notes: Ministries may be reorganised by the government formed after the 13 September 2026 election. Recheck names and addresses before opening.
recipients.why: forestry policy and reindeer husbandry are yours, and the forestry act that takes effect in January was written in your building

facts.text: The forestry law Ett tydligt regelverk för aktivt skogsbruk (prop. 2025/26:242), which cuts the notice before felling to three weeks from January 2027, was the government's proposal.

recipients.name: Klimat- och näringslivsdepartementet (Ministry of Climate and Enterprise)
recipients.remit: Climate and environment policy, the Minerals Act, energy policy, industrial policy and the green transition.
recipients.notes: Same caveat as ministry-li: may be reorganised after the election.
recipients.why: the Minerals Act, energy policy and the green transition are yours, including the uranium ban that was lifted in January

facts.text: On 3 September 2026 the government adopted Sweden's draft national nature restoration plan, 39 measure packages; the final plan is due on 1 September 2027.

recipients.name: Länsstyrelsen Västerbotten (County Administrative Board)
recipients.remit: Environmental permits and supervision, nature reserves, predator hunting decisions, the county's part of the biosphere reserve.
recipients.notes: Partner of the biosphere reserve. Inform before letters start.
recipients.why: you issue the environmental permits and manage the reserves inside the biosphere area the council speaks for

facts.text: In June 2026 you allowed 12,700 moose to be shot in the year's licence hunt in Västerbotten.

recipients.name: Länsstyrelsen Norrbotten (County Administrative Board)
recipients.remit: Environmental permits and supervision in Norrbotten, including the mining districts and Boden.
recipients.why: you recommended granting the Per Geijer concession while writing that the lost migration route cannot be fully compensated

facts.text: On 25 September 2026 you recommended that LKAB be granted the Per Geijer concession, while writing that losing the reindeer migration route ends the functional connection and cannot be fully compensated.
Your county governor has called for rules on heliskiing since 2023; county boards have no legal power to restrict it.

recipients.name: Region Västerbotten
recipients.remit: Regional development strategy, tourism and business development in Västerbotten.
recipients.why: you set the regional development strategy, and your own chair said the grid here is full

facts.text: In May 2025 your regional council chair said there is no great need for more wind power here and now, because the grid is full.

recipients.name: Region Norrbotten
recipients.remit: Regional development strategy for Norrbotten, including the green industrial investments.
recipients.why: you set the regional development strategy that the green industrial investments are built on

recipients.name: Umeå kommun

recipients.notes: Partner of the biosphere reserve. Inform before letters start.
recipients.why: the river reaches the sea in your municipality, past Stornorrfors, and you plan what happens along it

facts.text: Umeå hosts Rally Sweden from 2025 to 2027.

recipients.name: Vindelns kommun
recipients.remit: Local planning and wind power veto along the middle Vindelälven.
recipients.notes: Partner of the biosphere reserve. Small municipality: consider a weekly cap.
recipients.why: the middle Vindelälven runs through your municipality, and wind power needs your consent

recipients.name: Vännäs kommun

recipients.notes: Partner of the biosphere reserve. Small municipality: consider a weekly cap.
recipients.why: the Vindelälven meets the Umeälven in your municipality

recipients.name: Lycksele kommun
recipients.remit: Local planning and wind power veto in the inland of the biosphere reserve.
recipients.notes: Partner of the biosphere reserve. Consider a weekly cap.
recipients.why: you plan the inland forest of the biosphere area, and wind power needs your consent

recipients.name: Sorsele kommun
recipients.remit: Local planning in the upper Vindelälven, Sámi administrative municipality.
recipients.notes: Partner of the biosphere reserve. Small municipality: consider a weekly cap.
recipients.why: you are a Sámi administrative municipality on the upper Vindelälven, where tourism and herding share the same ground

recipients.name: Arjeplogs kommun
recipients.remit: Local planning in the mountain part of the biosphere reserve, Sámi administrative municipality.
recipients.notes: Partner of the biosphere reserve. Small municipality: consider a weekly cap.
recipients.why: four uranium exploration permits were granted in your municipality in August 2026, on the ground of the 1981 Pleutajokk protest

facts.text: In August 2026 four uranium exploration permits were granted in Arjeplog, where the 1981 Pleutajokk protest stopped uranium mining once before.

recipients.name: Malå kommun
recipients.remit: Local planning; exploration and mining interest in the Skellefte field.
recipients.notes: No general mailbox; this is the municipal executive board. Small municipality: consider a weekly cap.
recipients.why: exploration and mining in the Skellefte field reach into your municipality

recipients.name: Norsjö kommun
recipients.remit: Local planning; mining in the Skellefte field.
recipients.notes: Address found 1 Oct 2026. Small municipality: consider a weekly cap.
recipients.why: mining and forestry in the Skellefte field reach into your municipality, and you redid your wind plan in 2023

recipients.name: Bodens kommun
recipients.remit: Hosts the Stegra green steel plant; municipal debt taken on ahead of the industry. Home of Havremagasinet.
recipients.notes: The exhibition's host town. Tell Havremagasinet first.
recipients.why: you borrowed more than a billion kronor ahead of an industry that has not opened yet, and the council meets in your town

facts.text: Your loan debt grew from about 80 million kronor in 2017 to 1,790 million at the end of 2025, with a loss of 88 million kronor in 2025.

recipients.name: Sveaskog (state-owned forest company)
recipients.remit: Sweden's largest forest owner, owned by the state: fellings, set-asides, lodgepole pine plantations, consultation with samebyar.
recipients.notes: Only a customer-centre address is published.
recipients.why: you hold 14 per cent of Sweden's forest land on behalf of the state, and your clear-cut-free area was 37 hectares in 2024

facts.text: In your 2024 annual report, 26 per cent of your holdings are excluded from forestry, and the area you managed without clear-cutting was 37 hectares.
In January 2023 you cut regeneration felling in Norrbotten by 45 per cent, citing failed co-planning with the samebyar.

recipients.name: SCA
recipients.remit: Europe's largest private forest owner, in Norrland: fellings, bioenergy, wind power on its land.
recipients.why: you are Europe's largest private forest owner here, you keep planting lodgepole pine, and you felled in Ohredahke's core areas after consent was withdrawn

facts.text: Ohredahke sameby withdrew its consent to all felling in its core areas on 24 January 2025; Natursidan has counted more than 200 fellings by you there since.
In 2025 you announced you would leave FSC forest certification, then paused the exit after talks with Sámi organisations and FSC.

recipients.name: Holmen
recipients.remit: Large forest owner and hydropower producer; forestry in northern Sweden.
recipients.why: you own both forest and hydropower in the north, so both halves of this argument are your business

recipients.name: Vattenfall (state-owned energy company)
recipients.remit: Operates Stornorrfors and most hydropower in the Ume river system; first omprövning applications in 2026.
recipients.notes: Press desk; no general mailbox published.
recipients.why: you operate Stornorrfors and most of the hydropower in this river system, and your plants must hold modern environmental conditions by 2040

facts.text: On 20 February 2026 you filed your first applications for modern environmental conditions for large hydropower; Stornorrfors must hold modern conditions by around 2040.
In February 2025 the Land and Environment Court dismissed your application to rebuild Juktan as a pumped-storage plant as too unclear.

recipients.name: LKAB (state-owned mining company)
recipients.remit: Iron ore in Kiruna and Malmberget, Per Geijer rare earth deposit, fossil-free sponge iron plans.
recipients.why: you are state-owned, you produced 86 per cent of the EU's iron ore in 2025, and Per Geijer would leave one herd a fifty-metre corridor

facts.text: In 2025 you produced 86 per cent of the EU's iron ore.
Gabna sameby ended its cooperation agreement with you on 2 December 2025 and rejects the Per Geijer mine.
On 15 June 2026 you were granted the environmental permit for the HYBRIT demonstration plant in Gällivare.

recipients.name: Boliden
recipients.remit: Mines in the Skellefte field and Aitik; tailings and water.
recipients.why: your mines and tailings in the Skellefte field and at Aitik outlive the ore

facts.text: You ran the Laisvall lead mine on the Laisälven from 1943 to 2001.

recipients.name: Stegra

recipients.notes: Contact form only, no email address.
recipients.why: the plant in Boden is what the town borrowed against, and no start date has been confirmed

recipients.name: FSC Sverige
recipients.remit: Forest certification standard, including consultation on winter grazing land.
recipients.why: your standard is what consent on winter grazing land is supposed to mean in practice

facts.text: In 2025 SCA announced it would leave your forest certification, then paused the exit after talks with Sámi organisations and FSC.

recipients.name: Svenska PEFC
recipients.remit: Forest certification standard used by most small private forest owners.
recipients.why: most small private forest owners are certified under your standard

recipients.name: Svemin (Swedish mining industry association)
recipients.remit: Lobbies for the mining industry, including faster permitting.

recipients.name: Skogsindustrierna (Swedish Forest Industries Federation)
recipients.remit: Lobbies for the forest industry.

recipients.name: Skydda Skogen (Protect the Forest)

recipients.why: you track felling notifications and the old-growth forest they cover, and the CJEU case that carries your name decided what species protection means

facts.text: Your case led the EU Court of Justice to rule on 4 March 2021 (C-473/19 and C-474/19) that the species-protection bans cover every individual of a protected species.

recipients.name: Världsnaturfonden WWF
recipients.remit: Conservation organisation; forest and freshwater programmes.
recipients.why: your forest and freshwater programmes cover exactly this landscape

recipients.name: Greenpeace Sverige

recipients.name: Fältbiologerna (youth nature organisation)

recipients.name: Sportfiskarna (Swedish Anglers Association)

recipients.why: you have pushed for fish passages and the hydropower review longer than anyone, and the salmon count at Norrfors is the result

recipients.name: Ohredahke sameby
recipients.remit: Sameby in Frostviken, Jämtland; in conflict with SCA over felling in its core areas.
recipients.why: you withdrew your consent to felling in your core areas, and the fellings went on — the council has spoken about your no, and you should hear what it said

facts.text: On 24 January 2025 you withdrew your consent to all felling in your core areas; Natursidan has counted more than 200 fellings by SCA there since.

recipients.notes: Added 4 Oct 2026: writing to the Sámi communities directly rather than only about them. Address from Sametinget's list of samebyar. Small organisation: consider a weekly cap.

recipients.name: Girjas sameby
recipients.remit: Mountain sameby in Gällivare and Kiruna; won the Girjas case in the Supreme Court in 2020.
recipients.why: your case before the Supreme Court in 2020 showed that the right to the land is older than the papers, and every argument this council has about rights rests on it
recipients.notes: Added 4 Oct 2026: writing to the Sámi communities directly rather than only about them. Address from Sametinget's list of samebyar. Small organisation: consider a weekly cap.

recipients.name: Sirges sameby
recipients.remit: Mountain sameby in Jokkmokk; one of the post-Girjas plaintiffs.
recipients.why: you are one of the samebyar suing the state for the hunting and fishing rights on your land after Girjas, and the council has argued over exactly that right

facts.text: JK insists the Reindeer Husbandry Act overrides immemorial rights in the post-Girjas cases (April 2026).

recipients.name: Ubmeje tjeälddie (Umbyn sameby)
recipients.remit: Mountain sameby in Storuman and down the Ume river valley.
recipients.why: your herds use the upper Ume river valley, beside the Vindelälven, and winter on the reindeer grazing land around Umeå
recipients.notes: Added 4 Oct 2026: writing to the Sámi communities directly rather than only about them. Address from Sametinget's list of samebyar. Small organisation: consider a weekly cap. Sametinget lists a board member's personal address; inactive until the sameby has an address of its own.
